description: Parkings is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastruktur und Mobilität Stadt Biel. Dieser Geodatensatz enthält alle öffentlich nutzbaren Infrastrukturen zum konzentrierten Parkieren von Autos in öffentlichen oder privaten Anlagen. Es handelt sich entweder um unterirdische Parkhäuser oder um eine grosse Anzahl oberirdischer Parkplätze an einem bestimmten Standort, zum Beispiel beim Parkplatz am Strandboden. Coverage: Infrastruktur und Mobilität Stadt Biel. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastruktur und Mobilität Stadt Biel. It offers 5 resource(s) in DXF, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML, XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
